node.title: Re^9: Loading a part of the file to array using Tie::File
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You are correct on both points, although I didn't intentionally hide anything - most of the data I work with day to day is plain ASCII, so I just missed the encoding issue (and [doc://Tie::File] creates nonexistent files and I was testing in /tmp - but without or die it fails silently on e.g. permission denied, so that's not an excuse).

use Tie::File; use Fcntl qw/O_RDWR/; tie my @a, 'Tie::File', $file, mode=>O_RDWR or die $!; # but doesn't handle encodings # - or - use Tie::File; open my $fh, '+<:encoding(UTF-8)', $file or die $!; tie my @a, 'Tie::File', $fh or die $!;

Better examples, I hope. Thanks for setting me straight.
